description.plain:
Sunday, March 22, 2026 | 9:30 AM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX0000012iaf2AA/
Join the Worcester 20s & 30s on a 4 to 5 mile hike at Moore State Park in Paxton, MA. This hike will take us on several trails by a restored sawmill and stone mill foundations along the banks of Turkey Hill Brook, along with mouth-dropping rhododendrons, azaleas and mountain laurel (which won't be in bloom but are still impressive). We will hike through hardwood forests of oak, maple, and birch and pass by stone walls and several waterfalls. There are a few hills though elevation gain is minimal.Participants must bring:Minimum 1 liter of waterSnacks as necessaryLayers as the weather dictates, including outer shellHat, gloves, neck gaiter, depending on the temperatureHiking shoes or boots with good treadBackpack to carry gearMicrospikes and/or snowshoes, depending on the weatherBlaze orange (vest, hat, etc.) so you will be visible to hunters (Hiking is not allowed on Sundays, but always good to have)Confirmed participants can expect an email a few days before the activity with weather, meeting location, and parking details.After the hike, we will stop by somewhere nearby to grab a snack/lunch.

events.summary: 20s & 30s Social at Start Line Brewing Co.

description.plain:
Thursday, April 9, 2026 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000001310b2AA/
Join us for the April edition of the Worcester 20s & 30s monthly social series! We will be at Start Line Brewing Company in Hopkinton, MA on Thursday, April 9th starting at 6pm, but feel free to come whenever is convienent for you. Named after being less than a mile away from the start line of the Boston Marathon, Start Line Brewing has a variety of food, beer, and non-alcoholic options available. This is a great event for newcomers and returners alike - information will be available for upcoming trips as well as this being a good opportunity to connect with like-minded outdoorsy 20s & 30s folks. Hope to see you there!
